=== apostrophe
--- before
it¦
--- keys
's
--- after
it's¦

=== surround emphasis
--- before
a «b» c
--- keys
*
--- after
a *«b»* c

=== surround backtick
--- before
use «x»
--- keys
`
--- after
use `«x»`

=== autoclose bracket
--- before
see ¦
--- keys
[link
--- after
see [link¦]

=== link paren
--- before
[a]¦
--- keys
(u
--- after
[a](u¦)

=== list continuation
--- before
- a¦
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
- a
¦

=== html comment
--- before
«text»
--- keys
<bc>
--- after
«<!-- text -->»

=== line comment fallback
--- before
«a
b»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«<!-- a -->
<!-- b -->»

=== enter plain
--- before
para¦
--- keys
<enter>next
--- after
para
next¦

=== backspace pair
--- before
x ¦
--- keys
(<bs>
--- after
x ¦
